verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal offers a simulated card reader and API-based integration so developers can test payment flows without physical hardware, and the Stripe CLI can drive Stripe integrations from a terminal/script, both of which support automated/headless testing scenarios. However, there is no explicit documentation of running Terminal in a CI pipeline, no headless orchestration guide, and production use still requires a physical/simulated reader tied to a registered location, limiting fully agentic automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless workflow documentation, evidence of non-interactive end-to-end automation beyond simulated testing, and confirmation the simulated reader can be scripted in CI without dashboard interaction.
